SELECT * FROM t UNPIVOT INCLUDE NULLS (value FOR quarter IN (q1 AS 'Q1', q2 AS 'Q2', (q3, q4) AS ('Q3', 'Q4')));

================================================================================
MATCH_RECOGNIZE
================================================================================

SELECT * FROM ticker MATCH_RECOGNIZE (
  PARTITION BY symbol
  ORDER BY tstamp
  MEASURES STRT.tstamp AS start_tstamp, FINAL LAST(DOWN.tstamp) AS bottom, MATCH_NUMBER() AS mno, CLASSIFIER() AS cls
  ONE ROW PER MATCH
  AFTER MATCH SKIP TO LAST UP
  PATTERN (STRT DOWN+ UP+ | ^ X{2,3}? (Y | Z)* $)
  SUBSET STDN = (STRT, DOWN)
  DEFINE DOWN AS DOWN.price < PREV(DOWN.price), UP AS UP.price > PREV(UP.price)
) mr;

---

        (table_reference
          (object_reference

              (column_reference

            (order_by_clause

                  (identifier))

================================================================================
MODEL
================================================================================

SELECT country, prod, year, s FROM sales_view
MODEL
  RETURN UPDATED ROWS
  PARTITION BY (country)
  DIMENSION BY (prod, year)
  MEASURES (sale s)
  IGNORE NAV
  RULES UPSERT ALL AUTOMATIC ORDER (
    s[prod = 'Mouse Pad', year = 2001] = s['Mouse Pad', 1999] + s['Mouse Pad', 2000],
    UPDATE s['Standard Mouse', 2002] = s['Standard Mouse', 2001],
    s[ANY, 2003] = SUM(s)[CV(prod), year < 2003],
    s[FOR prod IN ('a', 'b'), FOR year FROM 2004 TO 2006 INCREMENT 1] ORDER BY year = 0
  )
ORDER BY country;

---

      (column_reference
        (identifier))

================================================================================
MODEL with a reference model and ITERATE
================================================================================

SELECT * FROM t MODEL REFERENCE r ON (SELECT a, b FROM u) DIMENSION BY (a) MEASURES (b) MAIN m DIMENSION BY (x) MEASURES (y) RULES ITERATE (3) UNTIL (y[1] > 10) (y[1] = y[1] + 1);

          (object_reference
            (identifier))))

        (reference_model
          (identifier)
          (subquery
            (select
              (column_reference
                (identifier))
              (column_reference
                (identifier))
              (from_clause
                (table_reference
                  (object_reference
                    (identifier))))))
          (column_reference
            (identifier))
          (column_reference
            (identifier)))
        (identifier)
        (column_reference
          (identifier))
        (column_reference
          (identifier))

          (number)

================================================================================
JSON_TABLE
================================================================================

SELECT jt.* FROM po, JSON_TABLE(po.doc, '$.items[*]' ERROR ON ERROR COLUMNS (
  row_no FOR ORDINALITY,
  name VARCHAR2(20) PATH '$.name',
  qty NUMBER PATH '$.qty' DEFAULT 0 ON EMPTY,
  has_note VARCHAR2(5) EXISTS PATH '$.note',
  NESTED PATH '$.parts[*]' COLUMNS (part VARCHAR2(10) PATH '$.id')
)) jt;

---

  (select_statement
    (select

              (identifier))

                  (number)))
